thread:
incident-bot: Paging: high error rate observed on /v1/generate (model=v4beta) — 5xx spike 00:12 UTC. Severity: P1. Pager: anna.

anna (oncall): I'm on it, ack. Any customer-facing alerts yet?

mike (sre): Seeing 5xx ~11.8% over 3m, p95 latency up from 220ms -> 980ms. GPU memory pressure on a subset of pods; OOM patterns + repeated retries.

sam (eng-runtime): Looking at traces — v4beta is returning malformed JSON in ~8% of responses which client SDKs are retrying, amplifying load. Stacktrace snippets: `panic: unexpected token` in tokenizer layer.

anna (oncall): OK that explains amplification. Can we quickly demote v4beta and route traffic to v4-stable? Need fast mitigation — reduce customer impact and limit retries.

sam (eng-runtime): I'm preparing a traffic shift. Plan: 1) Disable v4beta for public routing, 2) Reroute the model alias to v4-stable, 3) Enforce temporary per-key emergency quotas (100 TPS) and global rate cap to avoid replay storms.

tori (support): We have 14 customers reporting errors right now, top impacted: AcmeCorp (payment flows), NimbusAI (batch scoring). Support will notify high-touch customers and advise retry/backoff.

anna (oncall): Execute steps now. sam, mike — coordinate. I'll notify execs.

sam (eng-runtime): Running commands:
```bash
# mark variant disabled in control plane
redwoodctl variants set-disabled --model my-model --variant v4beta --disabled true --reason "P1: malformed responses causing retries"
# reassign alias to stable variant
redwoodctl routes update --alias my-model:prod --variant v4-stable
```

deploy-bot: Started rollout job 97531 -> updating route alias my-model:prod -> v4-stable.

mike (sre): While rollout proceeds, I'm applying traffic shaping rule to limit per-key TPS and global burst: `shaper apply --policy emergency-1860023456 --per-key 100 --global 2000`

anna (oncall): Good. Also add short TTL for cache warmup on v4-stable to avoid cold-start overload.

sam (eng-runtime): TTL set to 15s for prefix cache. Monitoring rolling.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: alias my-model:prod -> v4-stable (percent routed: 100%).

mike (sre): Post-rollback metrics: 5xx down to 1.2% within 3m, p95 back to 260ms. Error amplification dropping. Applying emergency quotas now.

mike (sre): Applied policy emergency-1860023456: per-key 100 TPS enforced; global cap 2000 RPS.

tori (support): Support note: contacting AcmeCorp & NimbusAI, asking to hold retries for 10min and increase client-side backoff.

liz (product): Are there any data regressions (meaningful quality drop) from v4-stable -> will customers see bad outputs?

sam (eng-runtime): v4-stable has slightly different completion patterns but A/B tests show quality delta <1% for top 20 customers. We'll monitor for hallucination/regression alerts.

anna (oncall): Handing incident to sam for mitigation & monitoring. I'm stepping off on-call in 25m — leaving a short runbook in the thread.

sam (eng-runtime): Taking over. Current mitigation summary: v4beta disabled, alias -> v4-stable, TTL=15s, emergency quotas applied. Monitoring dashboards pinned: /dash/incidents/1860023456.

mike (sre): Quick checklist for oncall takeover:
- watch 5xx & retry amplification
- watch queue depth and GPU mem on v4-stable
- watch per-key throttle violations (we'll whitelist emergency partners if needed)

tori (support): Customer impact: 22 affected accounts in last hour; 6 are high-touch. No billing anomalies detected. Logging the affected request IDs to a shared table for post-incident follow-up.

sam (eng-runtime): If we need to re-enable v4beta for testing, we'll spin non-public canary with strict quotas and synthetic traffic only. Do NOT route prod keys to v4beta.

anna (oncall): ETA for final resolution? Need root-cause fix ETA.

sam (eng-runtime): We have a fix branch that prevents the tokenizer crash; running a small internal validation now. If green, we can push v4beta-canary (<5% internal traffic) in ~90m, public re-enable TBD.

liz (product): Assign postmortem: sam (owner), mike (sre), tori (support) to contribute customer timeline. I'll draft the impact summary for execs.

sam (eng-runtime): Noting runbook actions taken:
- Demoted and disabled public v4beta variant
- Repointed alias my-model:prod -> v4-stable
- Applied emergency per-key quotas and global cap
- Shortened cache TTL to reduce cold start burst
- Support notified top customers
- Created follow-up: revert quotas after 3h if stable or earlier after thumbs-up

incident-bot: Incident 1860023456 status -> mitigated. Postmortem required.

sam (eng-runtime): Leaving continuous monitoring for next 2 hours. If we see repeat errors or throttle storms, we'll escalate to infra and consider temporary scaled-up capacity.

tori (support): Noted. Will keep customer comms updated in the support tickets and escalate any major customer impact to liz.

anna (oncall): Thanks team. Handing off fully to sam now. I'm clear.

sam (eng-runtime): Acknowledged — taking over. Will update thread with re-enable timeline and postmortem link when created.

mike (sre): Logging metrics snapshot for postmortem (attached in internal monitoring): 1860023456_metrics_snapshot.png

sam (eng-runtime): Closing mitigation loop: emergency quotas scheduled to be removed at 3h unless rollback required. Will file follow-up RFC for stronger validation gating on variant rollouts.

liz (product): Copy — will coordinate exec update and customer-facing note once postmortem draft is ready.

incident-bot: Incident 1860023456 -> status changed to monitoring.
